description: This file defines UI components for displaying categories in a Flutter app, including a model class, a list of demo categories, a categories widget, and a category button widget.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Model class representing a product category with optional SVG icon and route.

classes.name: Categories
classes.description: Stateless widget that displays a horizontally scrollable list of category buttons.

classes.name: CategoryBtn
classes.description: Stateless widget representing an individual category button with icon and label.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the Categories and CategoryBtn widgets.
